analysis_spec.detector_state: controller.evaluation_only.pre; near_object and far_object or far_objects[0]; no tracked predictions
analysis_spec.camera: rotate displacement by -yaw; zoom=.6*max(1-t,0)+16.2*min(t,1); window=(500+zoom*dx,200+zoom*dy); flip y=799-y; pixel=(84*x/1000-.0625,84*y/800-.0625)
analysis_spec.camera_note: continuous camera center, not exact rasterized bright centroid; fixed 4px absorbs rasterization/resampling
analysis_spec.matching: exactly one center within inclusive4px; unmatched and ambiguous retained; ambiguous candidates exclude their obstacle pairs
analysis_spec.physical_passage: first local forward front crossing -radius to first rear>radius; all hull/wheel polygon skins in raw front/rear; retain incomplete encounters
analysis_spec.physical_locality: abs(station-obstacle.station)<=40 and abs(road_index-anchor_index)<=15 at approach crossing; no seam wrapping
analysis_spec.sampling: 50Hz; passage includes crossing bracket and rear-clear tick; no sub-tick cleanliness claim; pass time is first strictly clear sample
analysis_spec.clean: complete passage, every bracketed raw clearance>0, no associated Box2D contact, no raw collision, no overlapping decision collision
analysis_spec.common_entry: first forward interpolated station crossing obstacle.station-25; reject negative/seam or initially beyond threshold; reject reverse/nonlocal/discontinuous entry-to-pass
analysis_spec.station_continuity: dt in(0,.020001]; road_index change<=4; station increment>=-1e-6 and <=hypot(dx,dy)+7; no wrap
analysis_spec.segment_eligibility: same geometry; both unique detected by pass, no ambiguity, valid common entry and passed; detection may precede common entry
analysis_spec.time_gate: strictly negative mean of per-cell mean matched common-entry-to-pass deltas; nonempty; also report segment-weighted mean
analysis_spec.speed_gate: >=2 distinct geometry seed values with candidate clean physical MIN actual raw speed>44m/s and uniquely associated adaptive+changed decision between common entry and pass
analysis_spec.other_gates: all48 valid slots, no operational retirements; lost finishes=0; per-cell damage AND collision decisions nonincrease; no whole-episode baseline-clean obstacle newly hit, including later reentry; fail closed on unassociated collision events in either arm
analysis_spec.hud: 44 is controller/HUD intended native speed target, not proof of actual44; estimate scale from pixel_speed vs mean(previous,current pre.speed); initial pre duplicated; clipped80 samples excluded
analysis_spec.failure: last10 decision endpoints, contact IDs, lateral/heading extrema, wheel road contacts, wrapper reasons; observational association not causal attribution
analysis_spec.safety: verify protocol/episode/raw/model/member/source hashes and first10 action/world parity; passive model-only evaluation, no tuning/reset/import of models or env
